#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""把 CSS Module 中的硬编码色值、旧变量名、阴影迁移到语义 Token。

用法：python3 migrate_tokens.py <file.css> [...]
只处理映射表内的已知值；未知 hex 保留并打印，交由人工判断。
"""
import re
import sys

LEGACY = {
    'bg-app': 'color-bg-app', 'bg-sidebar': 'color-bg-sidebar',
    'bg-sidebar-hover': 'color-bg-sidebar-hover', 'bg-sidebar-active': 'color-bg-sidebar-active',
    'bg-surface': 'color-surface-subtle', 'bg-surface-hover': 'color-surface-hover',
    'bg-input': 'color-bg-input', 'bg-modal-overlay': 'color-overlay',
    'border-subtle': 'color-border-subtle', 'border-medium': 'color-border-strong',
    'border-focus': 'color-border-focus',
    'text-primary': 'color-text-primary', 'text-secondary': 'color-text-secondary',
    'text-muted': 'color-text-muted', 'text-inverse': 'color-text-inverse',
    'accent-purple': 'color-highlight', 'accent-purple-bg': 'color-highlight-subtle',
    'accent-blue': 'color-accent', 'accent-blue-hover': 'color-accent-hover',
    'accent-blue-active': 'color-accent-active', 'accent-blue-subtle': 'color-accent-subtle',
    'accent-dark': 'color-dark',
    'radius-sm': 'radius-tag', 'radius-md': 'radius-control', 'radius-lg': 'radius-control',
    'radius-xl': 'radius-container', 'radius-full': 'radius-pill',
    'shadow-sm': 'shadow-none', 'shadow-md': 'shadow-none', 'shadow-lg': 'shadow-none',
    'transition-fast': 'motion-fast', 'transition-normal': 'motion-normal',
}

BG = {
    'ffffff': 'surface', 'fff': 'surface', 'f8fafc': 'surface-muted', 'fafbfc': 'surface-muted',
    'f1f5f9': 'surface-sunken', 'f2f3f5': 'surface-sunken', 'e2e8f0': 'surface-pressed',
    'e5e7eb': 'surface-pressed', 'dadde2': 'border-strong', 'cbd5e1': 'border-strong',
    '2563eb': 'accent-strong', 'ef4444': 'danger-solid', 'dc2626': 'danger-solid-hover',
    'eff6ff': 'info-subtle', 'f3e8ff': 'highlight-subtle', 'f0fdf4': 'success-subtle',
    'ecfdf5': 'success-subtle', 'fffbeb': 'warning-subtle', 'fef2f2': 'danger-subtle',
}
BORDER = {
    'e2e8f0': 'border-subtle', 'e5e7eb': 'border-subtle', 'cbd5e1': 'border-strong',
    'dcdfe4': 'border-strong', 'd1d5db': 'border-strong', '94a3b8': 'border-hover',
    '2563eb': 'accent-strong', 'ef4444': 'danger', 'dc2626': 'danger', 'c45c52': 'danger',
    'bfdbfe': 'info-border', 'e9d5ff': 'highlight-border', 'bbf7d0': 'success-border',
    'fde68a': 'warning-border', 'fecaca': 'danger-border',
}
TEXT = {
    'ffffff': 'text-inverse', 'fff': 'text-inverse', '0f172a': 'text-primary',
    '1f2329': 'text-primary', '111827': 'text-primary', '334155': 'text-label',
    '475569': 'text-secondary', '4b5563': 'text-secondary', '64748b': 'text-tertiary',
    '9ca3af': 'text-muted', '94a3b8': 'text-muted', '2563eb': 'accent-strong',
    '1d4ed8': 'info-text', '7e22ce': 'highlight-text', '15803d': 'success-text',
    '047857': 'success-text', 'b45309': 'warning-text', 'b91c1c': 'danger-text',
    'd97706': 'warning', 'dc2626': 'danger', 'a54239': 'danger-text',
}

DECL = re.compile(r'([\w-]+)(\s*:\s*)([^;{}]+)')
HEX = re.compile(r'#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})\b')


def table_for(prop):
    if prop.startswith('background'):
        return BG
    if prop.startswith('border') or prop.startswith('outline'):
        return BORDER
    if prop in ('color', 'fill', 'stroke', 'caret-color'):
        return TEXT
    return None


def migrate(text, path):
    # 1. 去掉 var() 的硬编码兜底值
    text = re.sub(r'var\((--[\w-]+)\s*,\s*#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\)', r'var(\1)', text)
    text = re.sub(r'var\((--[\w-]+)\s*,\s*\d+px\)', r'var(\1)', text)
    # 2. 旧变量名 -> 语义 Token
    text = re.sub(r'var\(--([\w-]+)\)',
                  lambda m: f'var(--{LEGACY.get(m.group(1), m.group(1))})', text)
    unknown = []

    def decl(m):
        prop, sep, value = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        if prop == 'box-shadow' and value.strip().split('!')[0].strip() not in ('none',) \
                and 'var(' not in value and 'inset' not in value:
            important = ' !important' if '!important' in value else ''
            return f'{prop}{sep}var(--shadow-none){important}'
        table = table_for(prop)

        def rep(h):
            key = h.group(1).lower()
            if table and key in table:
                return f'var(--color-{table[key]})'
            unknown.append(f'{prop}: #{h.group(1)}')
            return h.group(0)
        return f'{prop}{sep}{HEX.sub(rep, value)}'

    text = DECL.sub(decl, text)
    text = re.sub(r'rgba\(15, 23, 42, 0\.(?:34|4)\)', 'var(--color-overlay)', text)
    text = text.replace('rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2)', 'var(--color-focus-ring)')
    for u in unknown:
        print(f'  [保留] {path}: {u}')
    return text


for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    src = open(p).read()
    out = migrate(src, p)
    if out != src:
        open(p, 'w').write(out)
        print(f'已迁移 {p}')
